quadratic_source_principle.law: K=dGamma(h)=sum_ij h_ij a_i^dagger a_j with finite-dimensional Hermitian h, no higher-degree interactions, no displacement and vacuum energy fixed to zero
quadratic_source_principle.result: [K,a_j^dagger]=sum_i h_ij a_i^dagger on the finite-particle core; U(t)=exp(-itK) therefore obeys linear creation covariance with W(t)=exp(-ith). Vacuum is fixed.
quadratic_source_principle.boundary: Number conservation, locality and unitarity do not imply absence of higher-degree terms; the earlier local Kerr countermodel is preserved.

interpolation_obstruction.source_primitive: First mirror acting on labelled (u,x), S=[[-3/5,4/5],[4/5,3/5]], identity on spectators
interpolation_obstruction.duration: Dimensionless component s=t/tau, with physical tau>0 not supplied
interpolation_obstruction.projector: Q=(I-S)/2 on the active two-mode subspace, zero on spectators
interpolation_obstruction.same: At every integer component duration t=k*tau, exp(-2*pi*i*k*N_active)=I on every Fock number sector. Both laws give the same mirror S and the same coarse ordered cavity/detector histories.
interpolation_obstruction.different: At half-duration U1 differs from U0 by (-1)^N_active; their half-step coherent field phases and vacuum/one-photon coherence differ.
interpolation_obstruction.half_step_witness: Normalized (|vac>+|1_u>)/sqrt(2) has mean a_u=1/10-2i/5 under h0 and -1/10+2i/5 under h1
preserved: linear creation covariance at every time with each law's own W(t)
interpolation_obstruction.conclusion: Supplying a discrete mirror map and even quadraticity does not select its generator/logarithm branch or physical duration.

required_source_inputs.requirement: A native source principle excluding Kerr/higher-degree terms, rather than the desired coherent recovery inserted as a premise
Source Hamiltonians or independent continuous operation family selecting logarithm branch and ordered component durations
Source provenance for numerical mirror/loss coefficients, phase frame, clock and energy normalization
Keep the classical-memory scope or independently justify separated environment labels for a larger CP claim
